reviews.title: Great Alarm
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this for about a year and it works fantastic. I love waking up to my favorite songs. I change them up too so that I don’t associate one song with waking up. I absolutely love that I have this option. It has a Smart Wake function that calculates your sleep cycles. It plays a silent sound (or a different one if you want) as you sleep to stay connected to Spotify and plays the song you chose on repeat till you stop the alarm (sometimes I let it play for half an hour if I’m lazy). It has a regular alarm function and I don’t think it plays the silent sound as you sleep, and to wake you up it only plays a sample of the chosen song. I would use this more if it played the full song. You need premium or something to chose a playlist to wake up to. 
Sometimes it disconnects from the song, but it defaults to a shorter excerpt so you still wake up to a chunk of the song instead of the whole thing. My only complaint is that it seems to have disrupted my Spotify wrapped. It didn’t mess up my statistics but rather got rid of wrapped all together. I was pretty bummed so I looked for another app and couldn’t find one as good, so I’m going to continue using Alarmify and hope it gets fixed. 
It’s a great app overall, and I would highly recommend it to anyone not too attached to Spotify wrapped.
